subject: NovaxHealth: EU residency & deletion guarantees — procurement questions
messages:
From: Marie Dupont <marie.dupont@novaxhealth.fr>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: EU-only processing, backups & deletion evidence

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement and legal have a few follow-ups specific to our EU-only policy that we need clarified before we proceed:

- We require that all patient-derived inference data be processed and stored only within the EU (preferably eu-west-1). Does Redwood support an in-region-only processing option for hosted customers?
- We need a clear retention and deletion lifecycle for both live inference KV/state and backups (including snapshots and crash dumps). What are the retention windows and can you provide evidence of deletion?
- Under Schrems II we need to understand cross-border access: does Redwood staff ever access EU data from outside the EU? If so, what controls/justifications accompany that?
- KMS: can keys be customer-managed and located in-region?

Attached is an initial set of questions the legal team asked. Would appreciate concise answers and a proposed timeline for attestation artifacts (SCCs + deletion proof).

Best,
Marie
Procurement Lead, NovaxHealth

Attachments: Novax_Qs_initial.xlsx (spreadsheet of questions)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marie Dupont <marie.dupont@novaxhealth.fr>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only processing, backups & deletion evidence

Hi Marie — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary and suggested next steps: 

- Short answer on EU processing: yes, we support an EU-only deployment surface via our Private option (VPC/on-prem) and via regional Dedicated clusters in eu-west-1. For hosted customers on our multi-tenant fleet, we offer routing policies to keep inference in-region but metadata/control-plane signals may traverse our control plane — we can discuss stricter isolation.
- Backups & crash dumps: default backup snapshots are retained for 30 days; automated KV cache snapshots are ephemeral by default but can be retained per-customer up to 90 days on request. Deletion evidence: we provide deletion audit logs and a deletion artifact (signed manifest) after a purge.
- Cross-border operator access: Redwood operates a least-privilege escalation model; some operator actions are performed from US/EU depending on deployment. We can provide operator access logs and scope SCCs for EU-only operator access in Dedicated/Private.
- KMS: customer-managed keys (CMKs) are supported in Dedicated and Private; for hosted we offer Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) with KMS in eu-west-1 on request.

Would your team be available for a 30-minute technical Q&A tomorrow? I have looped in Laura (legal) to draft the initial SCCs answers. We will prepare a short mutual action plan and attach our SCCs response.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marie Dupont <marie.dupont@novaxhealth.fr>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T08:21:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only processing, backups & deletion evidence

Marie — following up with a technical/legal summary and proposed artifacts. Attached: SCCs_Novax_response_v2.pdf (detailed Q&A + controls mapping). Highlights: 

- Data flow and residency: For Dedicated/Private we guarantee that inference runtime, persistent storage, and backups remain in the selected EU region. For hosted multi-tenant we provide regional routing controls but cannot guarantee control-plane metadata remains in-region without Private deployment.

- Operator access & access controls:
  - All administrative actions are logged with WORM audit trails.
  - For Dedicated/Private, operator sessions can be restricted to EU-based operator pools; remote troubleshooting requires explicit customer approval and MFA with Just-In-Time access.
  - Operator artifacts (session recordings, debug dumps) are retained for 90 days by default and can be reduced via contract.

- Backups & snapshots:
  - Standard: rolling snapshots retained 30 days, encrypted with customer or Redwood KMS.
  - Deep backups (replicated for DR) are optional and can be disabled.
  - Deletion is a two-phase process (logical purge + physical garbage-collection) — we will provide a signed deletion manifest and the audit log entries showing the purge event and GC completion.

- KMS and key residency:
  - BYOK is supported for Dedicated/Private with CMKs in eu-west-1 (customer or partner-managed).
  - Key wrapping and re-encryption are supported for migration scenarios.

- Evidence and attestation:
  - We can provide: SCCs response mapping (attached), a SOC 2 Type II report, operator access logs for a 90-day window, and a deletion attestation letter after purge.
  - Timeline: draft SCCs answers + MAP by EOD Friday (2027-04-02); SOC 2 report and live operator logs require an NDA and secured transfer; deletion attestation will be issued within 5 business days of a confirmed purge.

Please note items that need legal/contracting agreement: in-region control plane guarantees (Private only), operator geography limitations (can be contractually restricted only for Dedicated/Private), and retention floor changes.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SCCs_Novax_response_v2.pdf

From: Marie Dupont <marie.dupont@novaxhealth.fr>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only processing, backups & deletion evidence

Laura/Karthik,

Thanks for the clear summary and the SCCs draft — that helps. A few procurement/legal asks before we move to contracting: 

1) We require an explicit clause in the DPA that operator access from outside the EU requires documented business justification and prior written consent; can you accept that for Dedicated or Private?
2) Backups: we need guaranteed destruction of backup copies (including DR replicas) and a certified deletion report. Your two-phase purge process sounds good — can you provide a sample deletion attestation template?
3) KMS: confirm that CMKs created in eu-west-1 will never be exported or replicated outside the region. Is multi-region replication optional?

Also procurement asks for a short attestation letter signing off on the above to accompany our internal risk board. Can you confirm whether Redwood will also share operator session logs (redacted) for a 30-day window during the pilot?

If yes, we can proceed to a short MAP and a pilot deployment in eu-west-1.

Regards,
Marie

---
NovaxHealth Legal (legal@novaxhealth.com)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: EU-only processing, backups & deletion evidence — Proposed MAP

Marie — looping in delivery & technical for a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can move to pilot. High-level MAP attached (MAP_Novax_v1.xlsx). Key milestones: 

- Legal sign-off (SCCs + DPA clause) — owner: Laura — target: 2027-04-06
- Pilot provisioning (Dedicated cluster in eu-west-1 + BYOK) — owner: Aditya — target: 2027-04-12
- Evidence bundle delivery (SOC2, operator log export, deletion attestation template) — owner: Karthik/Laura — target: 2027-04-16
- Pilot validation & deletion test (issue test purge, provide signed deletion manifest) — owner: Novax/Redwood — target: 2027-04-23

We will provide a short attestation template and a sample deletion manifest by EOD 2027-04-02. For the pilot we can enable redacted operator session logs for a rolling 30-day window, and we will restrict operator sessions to EU-based pools for the Dedicated pilot.

Please sign the MAP in the attachment and we will produce a DocuSign for the DPA + SCCs addendum once legal confirms the clause language.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: EU-only processing, backups & deletion evidence — next steps

Marie — thanks, all. Confirming the items Stephanie listed and next steps: 

- Laura will circulate an SCCs addendum + DPA clause language for your review by 2027-04-06.
- Aditya will provision a Dedicated eu-west-1 cluster for a 2-week pilot and enable BYOK. We will provide the pilot access URL: https://app.redwoodinference.com/deployments/NVX-canary once ready.
- We will send a sample deletion attestation template and a signed manifest example by EOD 2027-04-02 (attached to our shared drive).
- Operator session logs: we will provide redacted exports covering the rolling 30-day window for the pilot; full raw session recordings are treated as higher-sensitivity artifacts and require a narrower disclosure pathway (NDA + controlled transfer).

Can we lock a 30-minute call on Monday 2027-04-05 at 10:00 CET to finalize the DPA clause? If that works I will send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Karthik
